G. M-1-39
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...........
S.I.Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date October 13th, 1939.
Subject COMMUNICATION DATED OCTOBER 4th.,1939 FROM THE NETHERLANDS
CONSULATE - GENERAL CONCERNING Mrs.S.I. TRACHTENBERG nee TOLOKONSKY.
Made by. D.S.I. Maklaevsky Forwarded by. C Cla

The lady in question comes from a good respectable
Jewish family who had formerly resided in Irkutsk,Siberia,
where her parents had a haberdashery store.
In 1924 all the family left Irkutsk for Harbin where
they resided until 1932 and where the lady received her
education at a Catholic Convent. At the end of 1932 they
all left Harbin for Shanghai and shortly afterwards her
parents went to live in Tsingtao where they had opened a
small Restaurant which they still own.
The lady remained with her brother in Shanghai and
she shortly obtained a position with the local Russian
Daily " The Shanghai Zaria " where she had worked for
about 3 years in the capacity of an assistant to the
book-keeper. At the end of 1936 the lady resigned her
position and went to live with her parents in Tsingtao
where she also worked at their Restaurant in the capacity
of a cashier.
She is reported to be of very quiet nature and is
hard working girl. There is nothing to report about her
from the moral or political point of view.
There is nothing detrimental in Police Records to
her character.

D.C.( Special Branch ).

G. M-1-39
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号...........
特别处分站，
报告
日期：1939年10月13日。
事由：荷兰总领事馆1939年10月4日来函，涉及S.I. TRACHTENBERG夫人（婚前姓TOLOKONSKY）。
制作人：特别巡捕 Maklaevsky 转呈人：C Cla

该女士出身于一个体面正派的犹太家庭，其父母此前居住在西伯利亚伊尔库茨克，经营一家服饰杂货店。
1924年，全家离开伊尔库茨克前往哈尔滨，在那里居住至1932年，期间该女士在一所天主教修道院接受教育。1932年底，他们全部离开哈尔滨前往上海，不久后其父母迁居青岛，在那里开设了一家小餐馆，至今仍由他们拥有。
该女士与其兄弟留在上海，并很快在当地俄文日报《上海柴拉报》（The Shanghai Zaria）获得职位，担任助理簿记员，工作了约3年。1936年底，该女士辞职，前往青岛与父母同住，并在他们的餐馆担任出纳。
据报她性格非常文静，是个勤奋的女孩。从道德或政治角度来看，关于她没有任何需报告的事项。
警务档案中没有任何不利于她品行的记录。

副总监（特别处）。

Consulaat-Generaal der Nederlanden voor Midden-China

Tel. Adr. "Hollandia"
Telefoon: 80135/6
No. 3037.

9473
Shanghai, 4th October 1939.
9 Quai de France

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. B. TRACHTENBERG has applied to this Consulate General for a visé for admission into the Netherlands Indies for his wife SHEVA ISAEVNA TRACHTEN-BERG née TOLOKONSKY.

Mr. Trachtenberg, who is known to this Consulate-General, is employed by a Netherlands firm in the Netherlands Indies on a tea estate and arrived in Shanghai in June 1939 with six months leave in order to visit his mother who is residing at 203 Seymour Road, Apt. 5.

On September 12, 1939 he was married to Miss Tolokonsky in Tsingtao and has the intention to return to Java in the beginning of November 1939.

Mrs. Trachtenberg is born at Irkutsk in 1916 and is in possession of a Ta Tao passport issued at Shanghai on June 7, 1939 under No. 00285.

She seems to be registered with the Russian Emigrant's Committee in Shanghai.

Formerly she has resided at Shanghai on 1191/46 Bubbling Well Road.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know, if possible, whether there is anything known against this person from a political or moral point of view.

D.S.S. makalovsky

To the Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Vice-Consul
for the Consul-General.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆

电报挂号：“Hollandia”
电话：80135/6
第3037号。

9473
上海，1939年10月4日。
法租界外滩9号

先生：

谨此通知您，B. TRACHTENBERG先生已向本总领事馆申请为其妻子 SHEVA ISAEVNA TRACHTEN-BERG（婚前姓 TOLOKONSKY）办理进入荷属东印度的签证。

本总领事馆认识的Trachtenberg先生受雇于荷属东印度的一家荷兰公司，在一处茶园工作。他于1939年6月抵达上海，休假六个月，以探望居住在西摩路203号5室的母亲。

1939年9月12日，他在青岛与Tolokonsky小姐结婚，并打算于1939年11月初返回爪哇。

Trachtenberg夫人1916年出生于伊尔库茨克，持有1939年6月7日在上海签发的道达护照，号码为00285。

她似乎已在上海俄国侨民委员会登记。

此前她居住在上海静安寺路1191/46号。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否有关于该人的不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

D.S.S. makalovsky

致：
副总监，
特别处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

副总领事
代总领事。
